texts:
Agent Genesis turns a sentence or a selfie into a working 3D agent. The body is rigged before you see it, so it walks and emotes on arrival, and it comes with its own custodial Solana wallet, a custodial EVM wallet, a persona written from your description, and a voice you pick.

Text mode paints a full-body reference image, reconstructs it into a textured mesh on our own Hunyuan3D GPU worker, then auto-rigs it with a humanoid skeleton. A selfie takes the face pipeline instead.

Genesis needs a sign-in, because it writes the agent and its wallet to your account. Remix forks a public avatar into an agent you own.
